integrity: The exact algebraic proof supplies generality; the reproducible finite numerical checks support, but do not establish, the theorem. Literature comparison records scope and residual risks without claiming independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Two contact environments with swapped strictly positive off-diagonal rates; equal durations and identical recovery rates only.
Deterministic two-group disease-free linearization; no inference of finite-population stochastic persistence or nonlinear stability at the neutral multiplier.
Equivalent exact formulas elsewhere in the theory of products of positive matrices remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exact one-crossing epidemic threshold under alternating directed contacts
